messages.subject: bounding box display issue
parts:
Hello,

I'm hoping somebody has some insight on a bounding box issue I've run into.  I'm trying to plot sample occurrence locations on a map.  The following code produces a great looking map (ggmap_reduced.png attached), however, it only displays the center of my distribution and throws out 480 sample points outside the mapped area.

>plot(data, stratum = "Sample",
  longitude = "Longitude", latitude = "Latitude", map.source = "google",
  map.type = "terrain", color = "black", zoom = NA)

Warning: bounding box given to google - spatial extent only approximate.
converting bounding box to center/zoom specification. (experimental)
Map from URL : http://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/staticmap?center=39.039243,-109.954273&zoom=7&size=%20640x640&scale=%202&maptype=terrain&sensor=false
Google Maps API Terms of Service : http://developers.google.com/maps/terms
Warning message:
Removed 480 rows containing missing values (geom_point). 

I tried adding x,y limits at the end of the previous code:

plot(data, stratum = "Sample",
  longitude = "Longitude", latitude = "Latitude", map.source = "google",
  map.type = "terrain", color = "black", zoom = NA) + xlim(-115,-105) + ylim(32,46)

This displays the rest of the data points, however the base map layer remains clipped to the center of the distribution (ggmap_full_extent).

Thanks much in advance for any suggestions!
HelenB

messages.author: ff2288e13d5cc538
messages.subject: Re: bounding box display issue
parts:
Perusing info online, it sounds like Google is bit glitchy with this function.  If anybody else runs into this problem, I finally got the following code to work:

myMap <- get_map(location = c(lon = -110.5,lat = 38.54), source = "google", maptype = "terrain", color = "bw", crop=TRUE, zoom = 5)
ggmap(myMap) + geom_point(aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, color = "black"), data = data, size = 3) + xlim(-119,-101) + ylim(30,47.5)
